items.title: Fewer false damaged save reports
items.text: Fixed a case where a game could report a good save as damaged. It happened at the tightest lag limit in Threaded mode, when the game's save loading ran ahead of the memory card service.

items.title: Folder memory card save fixes
items.text: Fixed several cases where saves on a folder memory card could be lost, written to the wrong file, or read back as blank, including save files the device would not open for writing. Saving also skips pointless rewrites when nothing has changed.

items.title: Lower resolution scales render more accurately
items.text: Below 1x resolution, every game image buffer now gets an exact scaled size. Draws are no longer slightly mis-scaled when the scaled size was not a whole number of pixels.

items.title: Report a Problem tool
items.text: Settings has a new Diagnostics page and the pause menu has a Report a Problem row. They bundle recent session logs, settings, crash files, a photo and the paused frame into one report with sensitive details redacted, and after a crash, freeze or failed start the next launch asks once whether to send one.

items.title: Faster drawing in busy 3D scenes
items.text: The graphics renderer now remembers how it set up recent draws and reuses that, instead of working it all out again for every draw. This cuts the per-draw work in scenes with many similar draws, including when native scaling is on.

items.title: Faster paletted texture copies
items.text: Games that expand paletted textures on the graphics side draw thousands of tiny palette copies a frame. Copies that continue the previous one now skip most of the per-draw setup.

items.title: Faster handling of triangle strips
items.text: Triangle strips that games send as packed texture, color and position data are now processed in bulk instead of one value at a time. This cuts graphics-thread work in games that use those formats.

items.title: Fewer stalls in the CPU recompiler
items.text: The recompilers for the console's main CPU and IO processor now keep their compiled code in sorted per-page lists. Adding and clearing code costs less, which cuts stalls when new code is compiled.

items.title: Tales of Destiny opening sky fixed
items.text: The sky in the opening flight of Tales of Destiny now gets the correct fog value instead of a wrong one. A built-in game fix sets the VU1 clamp mode to Extra for it.

items.title: Haptic Feedback setting honored
items.text: Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting reliably. Changing settings while a game runs also no longer risks clashing with the emulator's own threads.

items.title: Enable Cheats toggle stays in sync
items.text: Turning on a cheat, importing a cheat file or merging cheat lists now flips the Enable Cheats toggle in Settings right away. Before, it stayed off until the next launch.

items.title: CPU timing follows real console measurements
items.text: Integer math, register moves, loads, stores and conditional moves are now charged one cycle each, matching timings measured on a real SCPH-30001 console. This brings emulated CPU timing closer to the real thing.
